author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಹುಟ್ಟುತಲೆ ಖುಷಿಪಟ್ಟು ಸಾಯೆ ಅಳುವರು ನಿನಗೆ
ಗುಟ್ಟು ಜೀವನವೆಂದು ನಗುಅಳುವ ಜೊತೆಗೆ
ಮಟ್ಟುಸಾಮುಗಳೆಲ್ಲ ಕ್ಷಣಕ್ಷಣವ ಜೀವಿಸಲು
ಮುಟ್ಟುನೀ ಪರಮಪದ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: They rejoice when you are born and weep when you die;
life’s secret is that laughter and tears go together;
all the rules and exercises are for living each moment —
so reach the highest state, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Birth brings joy and death brings tears; life holds both. Every discipline we take up is really meant to help us live each moment fully, and that is the path to the highest good.
